description.Name: The comparison of neural mechanisms underlying prospective vs. retrospective thinkings of sustainable behaviors

latestSnapshot.readme:
Hello, there. 
In our experimental design, we included two conditions: past and future.

For our MVPA searchlight analysis, we conducted classifications by subject and by picture.

Classifications by subject: Please refer to the files wholebrain_searchlight_MVPA_(subject_past).mat and wholebrain_searchlight_MVPA_(subject_future).mat.
Classifications by picture: Please refer to the files wholebrain_searchlight_MVPA_(picture_past).mat and wholebrain_searchlight_MVPA_(picture_future).mat.
